newsitem.title: UK: TWA boosts UK-St Louis cargo capacity.
newsitem.headline: TWA boosts UK-St Louis cargo capacity.

text.p: Trans World Airlines (TWA) said it will substantially increase its London Gatwick-St Louis cargo capacity when it adds new frequencies from May 16.

"Our current daily service on the route is operated with a passenger Boeing 767-200ER (extended range), which gives us 10 to 12 tonnes' capacity on each flight," TWA's UK cargo sales and services manager Peter Simmonds told Reuters.
"The addition of a second daily flight, with a standard 767-200, will add six to seven tonnes' capacity on top of that," he said.
He added that he was looking forward to selling the aditional cargo space which will become available on the route, on which he said "business is good".
